questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

Sheela tried __for argue with him__ though she knew it was of no use.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **to argue with him**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The original sentence is grammatically incorrect because "**for**" should not be used with "**argue**".
 
• The correct preposition to use with "argue" is "to" and "with".
 
• The infinitive form "**to argue**" is the correct construction to use in this sentence.
 
• The sentence means that Sheela attempted to argue with him, even though she knew it was pointless.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

**Corrected sentence**: *Sheela tried to argue with him though she knew it was of no use.*

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

The car was manufactured by the company in a factory overseas.

options.text: The factory overseas was used by the company to manufacture the car.
The company manufactured the car in a factory overseas.
The car was being manufactured by the company in a factory overseas.
The car was manufactured in a factory overseas by the company.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **The company manufactured the car in a factory overseas.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In active voice, the subject of the sentence should perform the action.
 
• **Structure of the Passive Voice**: Subject (The car) + Auxiliary verb (was) + Main verb (manufactured) + By + Agen (The Company) + Adverbial Phrase (____in a factory overseas)__
 
• **Structure of the Active Voice**: __Subject (The company) + Verb (manufactured) + Object (the car) + Adverbial Phrase (in a factory overseas)__
 
• To convert the given sentence into active voice, we need to make the company the subject and the car the object of the sentence.
 
• The sentence in option 2 correctly places the subject (**company**) before the verb (**manufactured**) and the object (**car**) after the verb.
 
• The sentence is grammatically correct and conveys the same meaning as the given sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate idiom for the given statement.**

Doing things in a hurry does not give fruitful results.

options.text: Wisdom is too high for a fool.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Haste is waste**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Haste is waste**" is an idiom that means rushing or hurrying through something can lead to mistakes and poor results. (किसी काम में जल्दबाज़ी करने से ग़लतियाँ हो सकती हैं और परिणाम ख़राब हो सकते हैं)

 
 
• **Example**: *She rushed through the project without careful planning, but as they say, haste is waste, and she ended up having to redo most of the work.*
 
 
 
• The phrase emphasizes the importance of taking one's time and being careful in order to achieve better outcomes.
 
• The idiom is often used to caution against impatience and encourage patience and thoroughness.
 
• In terms of grammar, "**haste**" is a noun meaning speed or urgency, and "**waste**" is a verb meaning to use or spend carelessly or without purpose.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• "**Nothing succeeds like success**" is a proverb that means success breeds more success or that successful people or actions tend to beget more success. (सफलता अधिक सफलता उत्पन्न करती है या सफल लोग या कार्य अधिक सफलता उत्पन्न करते हैं)
 
• "**Still waters run deep**" is an idiom that means someone who is quiet or reserved may have a rich or complex personality or inner life. (जो व्यक्ति शांत या संकोची है उसका व्यक्तित्व या आंतरिक जीवन समृद्ध या जटिल हो सकता है)
 
• "**Wisdom is too high for a fool**" is a proverb that means foolish or unintelligent people are unable to understand or appreciate wisdom or knowledge. (मूर्ख या नासमझ लोग बुद्धि या ज्ञान को समझने या उसकी सराहना करने में असमर्थ हैं)

questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

The garment business has made Archie rich.

options.text: Archie has been made rich by the garment business.
Archie have been made rich by the garment business.
Archie had been made rich by the garment business.
Archie is made rich by the garment business.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Archie has been made rich by the garment business.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• Passive voice is formed by using the object of the active sentence as the subject of the passive sentence and adding a form of the verb "**to be**" and the past participle of the main verb.
 
• **Structure of the Active Voice**: Subject + Verb + Object__
 
• **Structure of the Passive Voice**: __Object+ Auxiliary verb (has been)+ 3rd form of the Main verb (made) + Subject of the Active voice__
 
• In this sentence, "**Archie**" is the object of the active sentence, so it becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• The verb "**has made**" becomes "**has been made**" in the passive voice, and "**rich**" remains the same.
 
• The phrase "**by the garment business**" is added to show who performed the action in the active sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

questions.question:
**Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.**

A. disrupted, posing major threats to progress

B. global health systems have been

C. health services have been

D. overwhelmed and many essential

E. in fighting other deadly diseases
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **BDCAE**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Part B**: Sets the stage for the context of the sentence. It introduces the overarching topic.
 
• **Part D**: Provides more information about the global health systems mentioned in the first part of the sentence. It suggests a challenge or problem faced by these systems.
 
• **Part C**: Further specifies the context, narrowing down the focus to health services within the global health systems.
 
• **Part A**: Completes the thought by explaining the consequence of the disruption mentioned earlier. It gives the reason why the global health systems and health services are overwhelmed.
 
• **Part E**: Provides additional information about the situation, indicating that the disruption has implications for efforts in fighting other deadly diseases. It connects the disrupted health systems to a broader context.
 
• So, when combined, the sentence reads: "*Global health systems have been overwhelmed, and many essential health services have been disrupted, posing major threats to progress in fighting other deadly diseases.*"

Hence, **option 3** is the correct answer.
